speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience wheezing, chest tightness, or shortness of breath specifically when you exercise or encounter cold air? REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Hyperinflation of lungs with flattened diaphragms, no infiltrates or masses.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a history of asthma or allergies, and do you experience symptoms like chest tightness or wheezing that improve with a rescue inhaler? REQUEST TEST: Spirometry with bronchodilator challenge.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: FEV1/FVC ratio less than 70%, indicating obstructive pattern. Reversibility test shows improvement with bronchodilator.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a history of allergic rhinitis, eczema, or seasonal allergies, and do your symptoms worsen during specific times of the year or upon exposure to pets? REQUEST TEST: Total_IgE and Allergy_Skin_Patch_Test. Are you currently taking any medications, particularly ACE inhibitors for blood pressure, which can sometimes cause a chronic cough?

speaker: Doctor
text: Since your allergy and ACE inhibitor tests are normal, do you experience heartburn, regurgitation, or a sour taste in your mouth, especially when lying down or after meals? REQUEST TEST: Upper GI pH monitoring.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since your upper GI pH monitoring is also normal, ruling out GERD, do you experience any nasal congestion, post-nasal drip, or a sensation of mucus dripping down your throat? REQUEST TEST: Nasal Endoscopy.
